messages.author: 1fe638ac9008754d
messages.subject: Tutorial/slides on Stan language
parts:
Hello all,

Apologies for posting two threads in quick succession. I was wondering - are there any slides/quick-tutorials on Stan language? I am writing some slides for a class next week, and wanted to know if there's anything I could use as a sort of template? Of course, I would reference it. 

No worries if not - I will just go off the Stan manual.

Best,

Ben

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Tutorial/slides on Stan language
parts:
See:

http://mc-stan.org/workshops

for our slides, and

http://mc-stan.org/documentation

for doc and some recorded presentations. My latest
presentation on the language is here:

http://mc-stan.org/workshops/vanderbilt2016/carp-3.pdf

though that's the long form.

Feel free to borrow the whole deck.

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Tutorial/slides on Stan language [new syntax in Stan 2.10]
parts:
It's all in the manual on the develop branch of stan-dev/stan.
The design doc's here, but not everything's implemented:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Stan-3-Density-Notation-and-Increments

For 2.10, the following three changes are implemented:

* "target += <expression>" statement (increment_log_prob deprecated)

* changes to the suffixes used for probability functions, from _log, _log,
_cdf_log, and _ccdf_log to _lpdf, _lpmf, _lcdf, and _lccdf (with old ones
deprecated)

* use of vertical bar in probability functions (density, mass, cdf, ccdf)
for new function suffix versions

2.11 will bring the ternary operator and lots of vectorized functions.

- Bob
